title: How to Love Others in Times of Crisis
desc: I’ve been thinking about this and “social distancing” is a bad term! Not a bad concept from the standpoint of the pandemic and risk. But we should simply call it “physical distancing” and continue to find ways to build good friendships and social relationships…love others! Part of that is honoring the physical distance so as to not put others at risk. Still there are many ways that we can love our neighbors!

title: How Do You Spell Love...T-I-M-E
desc: What is God Giving Us in this Crisis? T-I-M-E! Here’s a great perspective from God’s Truth. You can choose to worry about what you don’t have and can’t do or control, or you can begin to develop the one thing God is giving you in this crisis – TIME – the one thing that spells LOVE to every spouse and every child out there!
